build_proposer: build a SingleSiteSimplexSpaceNMCProposer instance for a given RVIdentifier node with an optional transform
compute_alpha: compute the Dirichlet alpha parameters for a node using the Hessian of log probability in a world
get_proposal_distribution: get the Transformed Dirichlet proposal distribution for a node in a given world
review_compute_alpha: review the compute_alpha method to understand how Hessian diagonal minus max values predict Dirichlet alpha
review_get_proposal_distribution: review the get_proposal_distribution method to understand caching logic and fallback to ancestral proposer
